stem:
Which statement describes the relationship between x and y in these two equations? 

y = 3x
y = x + 3

options.label: A
options.text: In y = 3x and y = x + 3, the value of y is 3 more than the value of x.

options.label: B
options.text: In y = 3x and y = x + 3, the value of y is 3 times the value of x.

options.label: C
options.text: In y = 3x the value of y is 3 times the value of x, and in y = x + 3 the value of y is 3 more than the value of x.

options.label: D
options.text: In y = 3x the value of y is 3 more than the value of x, and in y = x + 3 the value of y is 3 times the value of x.
